error.catalog.bad_folder: That folder cannot be added: {reason, select, not_found {it does not exist} not_a_folder {it is not a folder} other {censored videos are saved there}}.
error.catalog.bad_type: {type} is not a video type this app knows, so the video was not changed.
error.catalog.item_busy: This video is in a job right now. Change its type once the job has finished.
error.catalog.missing: This video's file is not where the library last saw it. Add the folder it is in, or locate it.
error.catalog.no_such_folder: That folder is no longer watched.
error.catalog.no_such_item: That video is no longer in the library.
error.catalog.thumbnail_failed: No preview could be made for this video ({reason, select, not_video {no picture could be read from it} other {an error}}).
error.catalog.too_new: The library was saved by a newer version of BetaSuite, so this version will not open it. Update the app.
error.catalog.unavailable: The library could not be opened ({reason, select, corrupt {its file is damaged} busy {another program kept it busy} not_writable {its file cannot be written} in_use {the rebuild tool is using it} other {an error}}). The engine log has details.
error.command.bad_params: The engine refused a request because its {field} value was not valid. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.command.unknown: This version of the engine does not support the request {name}. The app and the engine may be from different versions.
error.config.bad_choice: The value for {path} is not one of its choices.
error.config.bad_type: The setting {path} needs a different kind of value ({expected}).
error.config.busy: Settings cannot be changed while a job is queued, running or paused. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it, then try again.
error.config.invalid: The change was not made because it would leave the settings invalid.
error.config.local_off: Local settings are turned off, so this change could not be saved.
error.config.local_unparsable: The local settings file could not be read, so it was left unchanged. Fix or remove it, then try again.
error.config.local_unwritable: The local settings file could not be saved ({reason}).
error.config.not_settable: {path} cannot be changed on its own. Change {setting} as a whole instead.
error.config.out_of_range: The value for {path} is outside its allowed range{odd, select, true { and must be an odd number} other {}}.
error.config.rule: The settings break one of their rules ({rule}).
error.disk.full: A disk is full, so the queue stopped. Free some space and run the job again; finished files are kept.
error.engine.internal: The engine hit an internal error ({exception_type}) and kept running. The engine log has details.
error.engine.stopping: The engine is shutting down. Restart it to run the job again; it continues from where it stopped.
error.file.failed: This file could not be processed ({exception_type}, during {stage}). The rest of the job carried on. The engine log has details.
error.job.bad_state: That job cannot do this now: it is {state, select, queued {waiting in the queue} running {running} paused {paused} completed {finished} cancelled {cancelled} other {stopped}}.
error.job.no_such_file: File {index, number} of the job could not be found, so the job was not started.
error.job.nothing_to_render: Nothing is chosen to hide, so the job would change nothing. Choose what to hide first.
error.job.unknown: That job is no longer known to the engine.
error.job.unsafe_setting: The job was not started because of the setting {path}: the app will not run with it unattended.
error.model.load_failed: The detection model could not be loaded ({exception_type}), so the job did not start. The engine log has details.
error.preview.bad_image: The picture for this preview could not be read.
error.preview.unknown_art: That picture is missing from the art style {style}, so its preview could not be drawn.
error.protocol.bad_encoding: The engine received a message that was not valid text. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.protocol.bad_envelope: The engine received a malformed message (field {field}). Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.protocol.bad_json: The engine received a message it could not read. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.protocol.hello_required: The app sent the request {name} before the engine was ready. Restart the engine.
error.protocol.line_too_long: A message to the engine was over its limit of {limit_bytes, number} bytes and was dropped.
error.protocol.unsupported_version: The app and the engine speak different protocol versions. Install matching versions of both.
error.run.locked: Another run is using this library ({program, select, betatv {betatv} betastare {betastare} engine {the app} migrate {the migration tool} other {another program}}). Wait for it to finish, then try again.
error.ui.engine.bad_message: The engine sent a message the app could not read. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.ui.engine.exited: The engine stopped before it answered. Restart it to continue.
error.ui.engine.hello_failed: The engine started but would not connect ({code}). The app and the engine may be from different versions.
error.ui.engine.hello_timeout: The engine did not answer within {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of starting. Restart it; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.ui.engine.line_too_long: A request was too large for the engine ({line_bytes, number} bytes, limit {limit_bytes, number}) and was not sent.
error.ui.engine.not_found: The engine could not be found next to the app. Reinstall the app, or start it from its own folder.
error.ui.engine.not_ready: The engine is not running, so the request {name} was not sent. Restart the engine.
error.ui.engine.python_not_found: Python, which the engine needs, could not be found. Reinstall the app to set it up again.
error.ui.engine.request_timeout: The engine did not answer {name} within {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}. It may be busy; if it stays stuck, restart it.
error.ui.engine.spawn_failed: The engine could not be started ({os_error}). The app log has details.
error.ui.engine.write_failed: The app could not send a request to the engine. Restart the engine.
error.ui.look.unreadable: A preview picture could not be read. It is drawn again when the screen next asks for it.
error.ui.video.dialog_failed: The file dialog could not be opened. The app log has details.
error.ui.video.not_found: This file could not be opened. Check that it still exists and that you can read it.
error.unknown: Something went wrong (code {code}). The app log has details.
